source.name: Drawn by this app from the counties CDFW's own regulation text names, over CDFW's county polygons (services2.arcgis.com cnty_basicplus_multipart_wm layer 0)
source.drawn_by: this app, as the union of the counties the regulation names
source.boundary_caveat: These lines are not CDFW's. CDFW publishes this area as a sentence and publishes no map of it, so this app drew it from the counties that sentence names, using CDFW's own county polygons. An area whose definition names anything other than whole counties — a highway, a river, a jetty, a tide line, a lake — is not drawn here at all, and this app quotes its words instead.
source.extent_caveat: The county polygons this app drew from end at the shoreline. They include the bays and they include no ocean, so a spot out on the water is inside none of these areas even where the regulation's county reaches it.
